title: Spicy Ginger Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy gluten-free meal made with the bold flavors of Vietnam. This spicy ginger stir fry is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onions and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the ginger and spicy sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes to combine flavors.
Serve the spicy ginger stir fry over rice noodles.
